image_description: A tall, dark-colored maypole stands in a grassy park setting with bare trees in the background. Colorful ribbons (yellow, blue, red, green, purple) stream down from a decorative floral wreath at the top. Several young children, mostly girls in light-colored dresses, are holding the ends of the ribbons and appear to be dancing or preparing to dance around the pole. The scene is outdoors under a bright blue sky.
